question: How is the desireful goddess identified in relation to Viṣṇu?
premises: A desireful goddess is referred to.
She is addressed in the context of this teaching.
She is proclaimed as the mother of Viṣṇu.
inference: The desireful goddess is proclaimed as the mother of Viṣṇu.
plain_english: O great goddess, she who is the desireful one is proclaimed as the mother of Viṣṇu.
